purpose: Teach: コレクター/木工/かなえ/ロマンス

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、本気で、絶対、コレクター、絶対、なの?本気で
lines.en: Mom — Dad really is serious about collecting things, right? He really is.
lines.style: Bright, rapid-fire curiosity. Open mouth on the opening question. Seeking confirmation with genuine wonder. Slight breathless quality — he's asking faster than he's thinking it through.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、本気で、絶対、木工、絶対、お得意なのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is genuinely talented at woodworking. He really is good at it.
lines.style: Warm, steady correction. Gentle emphasis on the ability itself. Speaking to him like his observation matters. Soft maternal tone without condescension.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お友達の、本気で、絶対、かなえ、絶対、ちゃん、絶対、お家に遊びに来たよ
lines.en: Mom! My friend Kanae really did come over to play at our house!
lines.style: Excited rush of words. Bright attack on the opening. Bouncy rhythm, like he wants her to share the news immediately. Genuine delight — he's bursting to tell her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママは、本気で、絶対、ロマンス、絶対、映画、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: Sho, your mom really does love romantic movies. I do, actually.
lines.style: Warm revelation, almost to herself. Speaking gently but honestly. A small smile in the voice. Sharing something true with him, not dismissing his observation.
